run_experiment: run a nevergrad experiment by name and save results to a CSV file
run_experiment_with_workers: run a nevergrad experiment with multiple workers for parallel computation
run_experiment_with_repetitions: run a nevergrad experiment multiple times with incremented seeds for reproducibility
run_experiment_with_plots: run a nevergrad experiment and generate plots from the results CSV
run_experiment_with_imports: run a nevergrad experiment with additional optimizer definitions from external files
